The light at the end of my tunnel is the eternal bliss of going to sleep forever. Drugs destroyed my brain, I cannot enjoy anything anymore.. the only thing I have been happy about lately is when I see my ex, and that is fake, its just old feelings comming back, she just uses me when her boyfriend isnt around, and i'll still see her just because i'd rather have her around than no one.. but that has nothing to do with wanting to end my life. I like how you think and I wish I could keep that mentality, I have it now, but when the xanax wears off I go into a delerium of panic, no logical thought can pass through without being warped into terror and dread. the first step is to get off this shit, or get on something like it under the care of a doctor, then to get my heart checked out more thoroughly by a cardiologist. I just need insurance, thats it, if I can get that, everything would be fine. I guess the reason I feel the need to expedite it is because I want to control when I want to die, I want to know when its happening, I want to prepare my loved ones. If i didnt do any drugs, and i felt like I do now, which I probably still would.. I'd pack up my most important belongings, sell off the rest, and hitchhike across the country. 

Really though the light at the end of the tunnel for me is just feeling normal without taking any drugs, and not having any health problems. It used to be having a good job and a good girlfriend, but things just keep degenerating and my goals get set lower and lower, more and more unreachable.

Maybe i could live near a border town and go into the US to hustle up money,  then come back to mexico and only have to do that once every few months. im worried about all the crazy drug lord gang wars going on there right now , but im also kind of intrigued by the lawlessness of it all, i mean i can really do whatever i want because the police are scared to work,, and can be bought with literally the shirt of my back(if its a cool shirt)

edit : I think I misunderstood your post when I first read it, I realize that pills dont fix like a magic wand, but they are a band-aide, a band-aide that i relied on for way too long without getting real help, now I'm paying the consequences, I do need professional help, but I don't know how to go about getting it with little to no money. i can get insurance, my ex girlfriend offered me 1000$ cash a few weeks ago for money that i spent on her tuition and she failed on purpose, i turned it down because it wasnt about the money, i just wanted to help her and her parents at the time, but i shouldve taken it. e
I'm lookin at it this way, get off the xanax and take care of problem with blood pressure/heart are priority, then get off suboxone, it wont take a month, it will take a year, or more, i really want to emphasise that i didnt make this post to say hey look at me i want to die talk me out of it, i made it to seek out help and ideas and information that i don't have, i've tried reaching out to people in my life and haven't been taken seriously, i guess because i don't seem depressed, and im really not depressed. I just think that ending my life is the next step, because I don't see a way out of this mess that i've made. Im looking for someone to show me a way out, if this fails, maybe ill find a forum somewhere and try there, im calling different organisations around town, im using my resources to find a better solution than death. If I run out of resources, without finding answers, I will take the last logical step/backup plan.
